rule: Summer hunting yields the autumn feather store
texts: Whenever a sky-cat hunts through summer, many feathers accumulate at the base of the cliff by autumn.
Whenever a sky-cat hunts in summer, the autumn feather store grows.

q2_gaps: a bare, non-deictic SEASON as a Time filler ("summer"): the structured Time terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute, and the season constants the instruction set names are deictic (last_spring, next_summer); nothing licenses a bare `summer` symbol (day-parts are the only bare-symbol precedent)

temporal-extent "through <period>" ("through summer"): During is licensed for during/while/throughout ONLY, Start/End need stated endpoints, and Measure ... duration needs a stated count — so the throughout/span sense of "through" has no licensed carrier and is silently dropped by a plain Time atom
review.notes: The generic bare-plural rule, the 0.8 strength for "often" with its QuantifierPhrase companion, and the sky_cat genus (noun modifier not exposed) are all correct. Time is the head the when-test selects for this PP, so the atom itself is defensible — what is lost is the extent sense of "through", recorded as a gap.

fields.sentence: Whenever a sky-cat hunts through summer, many feathers accumulate at the base of the cliff by autumn.
parse: (: skycat_hunt_feathers_rule (Implication (And (Member $c sky_cat) (Member $h hunt) (Agent $h $c) (Time $h summer)) (And (GroupOf (sk_feathers $h) feather) (CardinalityPhrase (sk_feathers $h) "many") (Member (sk_accumulate $h) accumulate) (Patient (sk_accumulate $h) (sk_feathers $h)) (Location (sk_accumulate $h) sk_base_1) (During (sk_accumulate $h) $h) (TimeAtMost (sk_accumulate $h) autumn))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: "many" used as a COUNT of things rather than a proportion: the instruction set assigns "many" to the strength dial (0.7) with a `QuantifierPhrase` companion, and omits it from the `CardinalityPhrase` vague-quantity list ("a few / several / a handful / dozens / scores / hundreds / a lot of"), so a counting "many Ns" has no stated channel.

Season names as time fillers, and durative span frames over them ("through summer", "by autumn"): seasons appear only as deictic constants (last_spring / next_summer), so a bare `summer` / `autumn` has no structured term, and the "through" extent has no carrier.
review.notes: The whenever rule, per-occurrence Skolem group `(sk_feathers $h)`, the `During` tie, "by autumn" as `TimeAtMost`, top-level definite base/cliff with `PartOf`, `sky_cat` genus with the noun modifier unexposed, and `Location` on the event only (no `LocatedIn` on the feathers) all follow the instruction set. `CardinalityPhrase "many"` is defensible under "use CardinalityPhrase only when the phrase counts things" but sits on the gap above.

fields.sentence: Whenever a sky-cat hunts in summer, the autumn feather store grows.
parse: (: whenever_hunt_grow (Implication (And (Member $c sky_cat) (Member $h hunt) (Agent $h $c) (Time $h summer)) (And (Member (sk_grow $h) grow) (Patient (sk_grow $h) sk_store_1) (During (sk_grow $h) $h))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever machinery with plain-variable premises, a per-occurrence Skolem consequent and the During tie; the three-word compound autumn_feather_store gets only its head-noun genus (both noun modifiers correctly unexposed) and the definite referent is a top-level witness reused as a constant in the conclusion, as licensed. Patient for the intransitive 'grows' follows the internal-change-of-state test; reading 'grow' as a scalar-change verb would instead give Theme, but no figures are stated so Patient is the better fit.
